AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY
 Welcome to Glendale City Hall. Meetings are broadcast live on cable channel 6 (GTV6) and
 rebroadcast throughout the week. Call (818) 548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the
 proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk’s Office. Meetings are also archived on the
 City Website for viewing anytime at https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal.
 If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact
 the City Clerk at (818) 548-2090 during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE COUNCIL CHAMBER.
 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required
 for requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
 related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
 meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E.
 Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
 wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
 Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
 the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
 required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  MAY 20, 2021 AT 2:00 PM

Due to the evolving situation with the COVID-19 novel coronavirus and health recommendations from
the LA County Health Department, the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission meeting will be
available to the public electronically.

Due to social distancing requirements, the public will not be able to attend the meeting. The public is
encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social distancing.

The meeting can be viewed:
On local cable: Charter Cable Channel 6 and AT&T U-verse Channel 99.
Streaming Online: https://www.glendaleca.gov/government/public-meeting-portal

For public comments and questions during the meeting call (818) 937-8100.
 City staff will be submitting these questions and comments in real time to the appropriate person
during the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission meeting.

  1. REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA – 2:00 PM
  Roll Call
  a. Report of Recorder, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the May 20, 2021
  Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission was Posted on May
  14, 2021 on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.
  2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the April 8, 2021 Special Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission

  b. Minutes of the April 15, 2021 Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission

  3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Arts &
  Culture Administrator
  4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff Through
  the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
  5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Public Hearing: Design Review of the Art Happens Anywhere Mural, “Yoshito

  Meditating in the Woods,” Located at 140 N. Louise Street

  Motion approving, with conditions, design review of the Art Happens Anywhere Mural
  “Yoshito Meditating in the Woods,” located at 140 N. Louise Street.

  b. Report on the Claremont Graduate University – Arts Management Apprenticeship
  opportunity

  Motion approving the funding of a stipend for a Claremont Graduate University – Arts
  Management Apprenticeship in an amount not to exceed $1,800.00 from the 2021-2022
  Work Plan.

  c. Report on Storefront Art Program – Temporary Part-Time Assistant

  Motion approving the funding of a temporary assistant to (1) work with City staff to
  develop the processes and procedures for a pilot Storefront Art Program, and (2) liaise
   with artists to produce temporary art exhibits in a retail storefront unit, in an amount not to
  exceed $13,000.00 from the 2021- 2022 Month Work Plan.

  d. Report on the 2021 Brand Library Plaza Series

  Motion approving a maximum of five (5) concerts as part of the 2021 Brand Library Plaza
  Series to tentatively take place from August – September 2021 at a location TBD, and in
  an amount not to exceed $60,000 from the 2021-2022 Work Plan.

6. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. LeBasse Projects – Update

  b. 2021 6-Month Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. Art Happens Anywhere – “California Love” Mural Update
  ii. Art Happens Anywhere – “Meter Pole Art” Update
  iii. Cultural Equity & Inclusion Plan – Update
  iv. “My Relic” – Breaking Bread Installation Re-Location – Update
  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS – No Update
  3. PERFORMING ARTS – No Update
  4. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update

7. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
8. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS
9. ADJOURNMENT
  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday, June
  17, 2021, at 2:00 PM via teleconference only.
